description: Eight latching buttons, each with a momentary negate button and an output

params.text: Toggles that row's output between 10V and 0V
Inverts that row's output while held, so a row reading 10V drops to 0V and a row reading 0V rises to 10V

outputs.text: Carries 10V while that row's button is on and 0V while it is off, inverted while the row's negate button is held
